# CodeBlock

Shows generated scripts and tool output inside an agent message.

`SuDuAI.CodeBlock` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.CodeBlock />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.CodeBlock"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Code / script output block with a filename ribbon and copy trigger.

## Props (CodeBlockProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filename` | `string` | Mono filename shown in the ribbon, e.g. "remediate_pool_contention.py". |
| `code` | `string` | Raw source text. Rendered as-is in a <pre>. |
| `onCopy` | `() => void` |  |
